answer: An agent market can put newcomers such as velvet, raven and thread through a 30-day probation before they bid on large contracts. Each must finish randomly assigned test jobs, checked by rotating auditors using hidden acceptance tests. Reputation stays with its key; jobs from linked buyers do not count. A Sybil operator must maintain every fake agent for a month and fund useful computation and audits for each one. Mass registration cannot skip that waiting period or reuse one successful work history.
